description: This file contains CSS styles and variables used for theming in a front-end application, specifically for light and dark themes, and includes styles for various components like App, App-header, and theme toggle button.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container class for the application, styling the overall layout, background color, and text color.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Class to style the application logo with specific height and animation options.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Class for the header section of the application, managing layout, background, and text styles.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Class for styling links within the application, with color transitions.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Class for the theme toggle button, providing styles for positioning, background, color, and hover effects.
